title: Handley Page Halifax (LW598) / OW-J 'Johnnie'
memorial_details: description: Silhouette of Halifax/ TO THE MEMORY OF/ NAMES (6)/ MEMBERS OF 426 (CANADIAN) SQUADRON FROM LINTON on OUSE/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES IN A HALIFAX BOMBER WHICH CRASHED/ NEAR THIS SITE AFTER RETURING FROM OPERATIONS/ 4.00am 9th June 1944/ They gave their today for our tomorrow
